name: Nagashima (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nagashima town emblem in blue, light blue and red: a blue stylised letter e with light blue waves and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nagashima, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.
